Load CRD features + summary stats over OCRs per CRD
```{r load_CRD_features}
all.CRD.features.df <- 
    check_cached_results(
        results_file=ALL_CRD_STATS_TSV_FILEPATH,
        force_redo=FORCE_REDO,
        results_fnc=
            function() {
                list_all_results_files_in_set(set.name='CRD.stats') %>% 
                results_filter_fnc() %>% 
                mutate(
                    CRD.stats=
                        future_pmap(
                            .l=list(filepath),
                            .progress=TRUE,
                            .f=read_tsv,
                            show_col_types=FALSE
                        )
                ) %>%
                unnest(CRD.stats)
            }
    ) %>% 
    select(
        CPM.cutoff, residual.model, 
        # z.score.counts, n.SVs, SVs.included,
        is.decorate.filtered,
        AD.definition.column, sample.strategy, meanClusterSize, merging.level, 
        CRDID, CRD.feature.type, CRD.feature, CRD.value
    )
```
